_doc: #fgs-timeout exemptions for cloud-android-fgs-timeout-guard.py. Each key is a repo-relative source file that enters a foreground from a worker without core DataSyncBudget, with the reason. A key whose file no longer has such a call is stale and turns the guard red.

exempt_workers.ac_cloud-chat/libraries/@mattermost/rnsh: Upstream Mattermost React Native share module (no libs:core link). One-shot, user-started share upload, never periodic; its module pins work-runtime 2.10.0, whose SystemForegroundService stops the work on onTimeout.
